# Napier

VS Equine have purpose built facilities at the Hawkes Bay Showgrounds and offers a mobile veterinary service from Vet Services Napier.

#### VS EQUINE HAWKE’S BAY PROVIDES A COMPREHENSIVE SERVICE FOR ALL EQUINES ACROSS THE REGION. 

Our Vet Services Napier clinic was established in 2012 to cater for the growing demands of veterinary care in the Napier area. In late 2022, we moved into a brand new building  which now provides an extensive range of expertise in companion animal, production animal, and equine disciplines all under one roof.

EQUINE FACILITY LOCATION & MOBILE VET SERVICE

Our Equine facility is located at Hawkes Bay Showgrounds. If you would like to bring your horse to us our equine vets can offer consultations and treatment at the showgrounds, with yards, safe parking and equipment for your convenience.

OUR EQUINE SERVICES

Dave Kruger is our equine veterinarian based from our Napier clinic. He is very experienced in equine dentistry, lameness investigation, and foot balance diagnostic imagery. Dave has always had a passion for equestrian and water sports and is actively involved in the Hawke’s Bay Endurance Club.

## Kv9 Pilot Study

Purpose of study: 

To assess efficacy and safety of Kv9 across a range of solid tumours. 

Eligible tumour types: 

  * Soft tissue sarcomas 

  * Mast cell tumours 

  * Mammary gland tumours

  * Melanomas 

  * Anal gland tumours 

  * Squamous cell carcinomas 

  * Other tumours may be considered 

Primary eligibility criteria*: ​

  * Tumour type diagnosed by fine needle aspirate or biopsy by a registered veterinary pathologist 

  * ​Tumour (approximately) measurements between 1cm and 5cm at the widest point

  * Not receiving chemotherapy or immune modulatory drugs

    * It is acceptable to be taking/receiving including apoquel, cytopoint, beranza or a recent vaccination 

  * No wounds on the surface of soft tissue sarcoma tumours

    * Other tumour types will be a case by case basis ​

*See referral form for complete criteria 

Treatment centres: 

  * Auckland

    * Onewa Road Veterinary Hospital

    * CareVets Glen Eden ​

    * Remuera Veterinary Clinic & Hospital

We do also use specialist veterinary laboratories to help us find out what is going on inside your pet.

Lab testing involves taking samples of blood, urine, faeces, skin, lumps or even areas of infection. Sometimes it can be as simple as getting a small drop of blood. Other times it can require surgery. Whatever sample is needed we take good care to cause the least discomfort to your pet.

### Where to Get Pet Imaging and Diagnostics

Lab testing is available at Rappaw Central Veterinary Hospital, Rappaw Tawa, and Rappaw Plimmerton. X-rays and ultrasounds are offered at our Central and Tawa clinics. 

Get fast answers and peace of mind with advanced imaging and diagnostic services – book your pet’s assessment now.
